items.headline: Coastal alert for the adjacent shoreline: Coastal Flood Warning
items.line: Issued for Coastal Flagler; NWS places the venue in no land forecast zone (AMZ454), 1 mile from that zone. It covers the shoreline next to the venue, not the venue's own zone. In effect until 7 p.m. Wednesday during the event.
